phases.name: Ship twice a week
phases.label: Phase 6
phases.milestone: Steady weekly rhythm, no post office trips

tasks.title: Change item location to ZIP 80214
tasks.detail: Seller Hub → account settings. Replaces the default 22201 (Arlington, VA).

tasks.title: Create shipping policy "Card lots – Ground Advantage"
tasks.detail: Calculated, buyer pays, USPS Ground Advantage only, 3 business days handling, domestic, no combined shipping discount.

tasks.title: Create a USPS.com account
tasks.detail: Needed for recurring pickups.

tasks.title: Order 100 #4 bubble mailers (9.5×14.5)
tasks.detail: The common 8.5×12 is too narrow for a binder page.

tasks.title: Order 200 chipboard sheets (9×12)
tasks.detail: Two per package so pages can't bend.

tasks.title: Order gallon zip bags, 5 small boxes (12×9×2), postal scale, tape
tasks.detail: Boxes are for Spurs and Mavericks. Half-sheet labels optional; skip a thermal printer.

tasks.title: Weigh 3–4 packed lots and send Claude the weights
tasks.detail: Corrects every listing's shipping weight.

tasks.title: Sort NBA pages into stacks
tasks.detail: Use the lot tracker below. Sticky-note each stack, e.g. "Nets A – pp 1, 2, 6, 7, 10".

tasks.title: Sort MLB pages into stacks
tasks.detail: Same method. Store stacks in tracker order.

tasks.title: Retake Celtics page 9 front photo
tasks.detail: Drop it in the Celtics folder.

tasks.title: Switch drafts to the Lots category and fill lot specifics
tasks.detail: Category 261329; sport, team, season, manufacturer, card count.

tasks.title: Split teams into new drafts with mixed page photos
tasks.detail: Existing draft becomes lot A; new drafts for B–D. Every front and back pictured.

tasks.title: Rewrite titles, descriptions, condition and prices
tasks.detail: Accurate RC/serial/auto wording, pages listed, Excellent for 1990s lots, ask and 75% floor.

tasks.title: Decide on Best Offer auto-accept at 90% of ask
tasks.detail: Cuts buyer messages. Declines below 75% happen either way.

tasks.title: Review the summary and spot-check 4–5 drafts
tasks.detail: Compare against the stacks.

tasks.title: Confirm settings and stacks are done
tasks.detail: ZIP 80214, shipping policy, all stacks labeled.

tasks.title: List all 75 drafts
tasks.detail: Seller Hub → Drafts → List it. Buy It Now, Good 'Til Cancelled, Best Offer on, no promoted listings.

tasks.title: Verify all 75 are live with the right prices
tasks.detail: Tell Claude when you're done listing.

tasks.title: Set up recurring USPS pickup for Tue and Fri
tasks.detail: USPS.com → Package Pickup → recurring.

tasks.title: Pack nights: Monday and Thursday
tasks.detail: Seller Hub → Awaiting shipment → pull stack, pack, weigh, print the eBay label. ~20–45 min.

tasks.title: Mark lots Sold and Shipped in the tracker
tasks.detail: Add the sale price so the review has real numbers.

tasks.title: Pull sales data and time per package
tasks.detail: Sell-through by lot size and sport, prices vs. asks, offers, your real hourly rate.

tasks.title: Decide next steps for unsold lots
tasks.detail: Options checked against your pricing guardrails. No changes without your OK.

notes: Source of truth is the page database (tasks 23, phases 7). Tracks kept as launch/run. The db 'kind' field is you/claude (who does it), so every item maps to kind 'should'. Three tasks are done (the three Phase 4 draft-building items). Due dates come from the db; two recurring run items have none. The page also has a lot tracker (75 lots with per-lot status) in a 'lots' collection; not extracted as tasks. Overlaps with Card Sales lane 2 (cs-20..cs-33): see the Card Sales notes. The Card Sales lane lists a few items not in this roadmap (retake Blue Jays C page 10 photo, log eBay payouts); this roadmap lists a few not in Card Sales (USPS.com account, weigh 3-4 packed lots, mark lots Sold/Shipped in tracker, recurring USPS pickup).
